fact: The Government of Mauritius launched a public consultation on 10 April 2025 on a draft report on child online safety, posted on the ministry website, with views taken by email or the MAIA+ chatbot from 15 April 2025.
The National Agency for Drug Control runs the National Submission Portal for Cannabis Policy Reform, collecting public comments and proposals online until 21 June 2026.
